mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS accountId, a.protocol_id AS protocolId, a.protocol_account_id AS protocolAccountId, a.group_baseline_state AS groupBaselineState, b.baseline_group_jids AS baselineGroupJidsJson, b.baseline_group_subjects AS baselineGroupSubjectsJson, b.group_count AS groupCount FROM account a LEFT JOIN account_group_baseline b ON b.account_id = a.id WHERE a.id = #{accountId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO account_group_baseline ( account_id, baseline_group_jids, baseline_group_subjects, group_count, captured_at, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT a.id, #{baseline.baselineGroupJidsJson}, #{baseline.baselineGroupSubjectsJson}, #{baseline.groupCount}, #{capturedAt}, #{now}, #{now} FROM account a WHERE a.id = #{baseline.accountId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.group_baseline_state = 1
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE account_id = account_group_baseline.account_id
mapper.select: SELECT group_jid FROM account_group_membership WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND membership_status IN #{status} AND group_jid IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(group_jid) <> '' ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT group_jid FROM account_group_membership WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND membership_status IN #{status} AND COALESCE(status_source, '') <> 'WGP2_ADD' AND group_jid IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(group_jid) <> '' ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT account_id AS accountId, group_jid AS groupJid, membership_status AS membershipStatus, status_updated_at AS statusUpdatedAt FROM account_group_membership WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (account_id, group_jid) IN

SELECT g.id FROM group_link_preview p INNER JOIN group_link g ON g.id = p.group_link_id WHERE p.group_jid = #{groupJid} ORDER BY CASE WHEN g.deleted_at IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, g.id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE group_link SET deleted_at = NULL, group_name = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{groupName}), ''), group_name), membership_state = CASE WHEN membership_state = 3 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END, sync_protocol_mask = CASE WHEN sync_protocol_mask = 0 THEN #{syncProtocolMask} WHEN sync_protocol_mask = #{syncProtocolMask} THEN sync_protocol_mask ELSE 3 END, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{groupLinkId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO group_link_preview ( group_link_id, group_jid, wa_subject, member_size, owner_phone, announce_only, avatar_url, last_preview_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{groupLinkId}, #{groupJid}, #{subject}, #{memberSize}, #{ownerPhone}, #{announceOnly}, #{avatarUrl}, #{syncAt}, #{now}, #{now} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE group_jid = VALUES(group_jid), wa_subject = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(VALUES(wa_subject)), ''), wa_subject), member_size = COALESCE(VALUES(member_size), member_size), owner_phone = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(VALUES(owner_phone)), ''), owner_phone), announce_only = COALESCE(VALUES(announce_only), announce_only), avatar_url = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(VALUES(avatar_url)), ''), avatar_url), last_preview_at = VALUES(last_preview_at), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.update: UPDATE group_link_preview SET group_jid = #{groupJid}, wa_subject = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{waSubject}), ''), wa_subject), member_size = COALESCE(#{memberSize}, member_size), owner_phone = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{ownerPhone}), ''), owner_phone), announce_only = COALESCE(#{announceOnly}, announce_only), avatar_url = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{avatarUrl}), ''), avatar_url), last_preview_at = #{lastPreviewAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE group_link_id = #{groupLinkId}

VALUES(membership_status) = 1 THEN COALESCE(VALUES(last_seen_at), account_group_membership.last_seen_at) ELSE account_group_membership.last_seen_at END, membership_status = CASE WHEN mapper.update: UPDATE account_group_membership SET group_link_id = #{groupLinkId}, joined_at = CASE WHEN AND #{membershipStatus} = 1 AND membership_status IN (3, 4, 5) THEN #{joinedAt} WHEN joined_at IS NULL AND #{membershipStatus} = 1 THEN #{joinedAt} ELSE joined_at END, is_admin = CASE WHEN THEN COALESCE(#{admin}, is_admin) ELSE is_admin END, last_seen_at = CASE WHEN AND #{membershipStatus} = 1 THEN COALESCE(#{lastSeenAt}, last_seen_at) ELSE last_seen_at END, membership_status = CASE WHEN THEN #{membershipStatus} ELSE membership_status END, status_source = CASE WHEN THEN #{statusSource} ELSE status_source END, status_updated_at = GREATEST(status_updated_at, #{statusUpdatedAt}), deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = GREATEST(updated_at, #{updatedAt}) WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND group_jid = #{groupJid} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS accountId, a.protocol_id AS protocolId, a.protocol_account_id AS protocolAccountId, a.ws_phone AS wsPhone FROM account_group_membership m INNER JOIN account a ON a.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND a.id = m.account_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.protocol_account_id IS NOT NULL AND a.protocol_account_id != '' AND a.ws_phone IS NOT NULL AND a.ws_phone != '' INNER JOIN account_state s ON s.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND s.account_id = a.id AND s.login_state = #{onlineLoginState} WHERE m.group_link_id = #{groupLinkId} AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.membership_status IN (1, 2) ORDER BY COALESCE(m.is_admin, 0) DESC, COALESCE(m.last_seen_at, 0) DESC, m.id ASC LIMIT 1
